layout.feed: Light ground (body, not .dark), ink type. Size tag "SHOWN MAGNIFIED / ABOUT 16.5 MM INSIDE", kit .sizetag 30 px, padding 8/16, centred, 820-912 (x 321-759), in --ink-soft so it reads as the ring's caption under the brand; gaps 23 px to the lowest prong and 28 px to the wordmark. The sides of the ring leave at most about 340 px, too narrow for the 438 px tag. Card top 940 to 1252 on plain saffron floor: logo_ink, name, ₹1,049, the line, the offer box (x 177-903) with a lozenge in the stones' own green (#196B3E, sampled). No scrim.
layout.story: Native 9:16 frame (Story y = display y - 7.5; the ring at 656-1370). The whole card moves above the ring and ends by 626: logo_ink 270-326; name and price on one baseline at 338 (glyphs 332-400); line at 410 (406-444); offer 458-520; size tag in the Feed's two-line form at the brief's Story 26 px, 540-626 (x 346-734), ink-soft. A one-line tag ran 720-820 px wide and read as a second offer bar under the first, so the two-line form was kept.
layout.contrast: Measured against the picture under each text box (median, 2nd percentile). Feed: tag ink-soft 7.3 (4.7, where the box edge meets the shadow), card 10.7-11.0. Story (darker saffron at the top of the frame): wordmark 5.8, name/price 5.9, line 6.0, offer 6.1, tag ink-soft 4.2 (3.9; 26 px Jost 500 counts as large text). Bone would read 1.4-2.8:1 on this ground, so all type is ink.

copyChanges: Archetype A5 to A1: the numeral panel, label and footnote are dropped; the card line now carries "adjustable US 5 to 9" (products.md: open back adjustable US 5-9; allowed words emerald-green cubic zirconia, silver tone, adjustable).

truthNotes: Construction faithful to the upright reference: about 7 emerald-green ovals in 4 claws, alternating either side of one scalloped clear pavé S-wave; open back with two looped tips and a gap; cool silver tone; true contact shadow.
Oval / inner opening 0.19 (brief asked 0.25-0.35 from 5 / 16.5 mm; the upright reference itself measures 0.19).
The ring is turned about 50 degrees, so it is 0.68 as wide as tall and spans 45% of the width.
Headroom: the ring's top arc sits 79 px from the top of the Feed; that is the most this picture allows (P 100).
abTest: First Verdant Eternity ad in ads-500 and the first A1 on a saturated light ground (green on saffron). Not a single-variable test.
deployment: Feed and Story both carry the card and the size tag. Not scored yet.
